abstract: Codon usage bias is a fundamental feature of genomic organization whose relationship with cancer-associated transcriptional states remains incompletely understood. Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by aggressive progression and limited therapeutic options. Here, we investigated nucleotide, codon, and amino acid composition associated with the malignant ductal cell state using publicly available single-cell RNA sequencing data. Comparing malignant and nonmalignant ductal cells, we identified distinct sequence characteristics associated with malignancy. Genes up-regulated in malignant cells exhibited higher GC content, preferential use of G- and C-ending synonymous codons, higher frequency of preferred codons (FOP), lower effective numbers of codons (ENC), and lower length-normalized minimum free-energy values than did down-regulated genes. Distinct nucleotide and amino acid composition patterns were also observed. Expression-weighted codon demand analysis at the donor/pseudobulk level further revealed differences between malignant and nonmalignant transcriptional programs. These codon usage patterns were reproduced in a second PDAC single-cell RNA-seq cohort. Bulk RNA-seq analysis further showed that highly expressed transcript isoforms tended to exhibit higher FOP and lower ENC than did less highly expressed isoforms. Reporter experiments demonstrated associations between synonymous codon composition and mRNA abundance and protein output, with stronger effects in pancreatic cancer cells than in non-cancer-derived cells. Together, these findings indicate that malignant ductal transcriptional programs and highly expressed PDAC transcript isoforms exhibit distinct codon usage and sequence-composition characteristics. Their convergence across independent cellular, transcript-level, and experimental analyses supports an association between synonymous codon composition and gene-expression characteristics in pancreatic cancer, providing a foundation for further investigation of their functional relevance.
key_points_ko: 악성 관세포에서 발현이 증가된 유전자는 높은 GC 함량과 G/C로 끝나는 동의 코돈을 선호하는 경향을 나타냈습니다.
췌장암 세포에서 발현량이 높은 유전자형은 선호 코돈 빈도(FOP)가 높고 유효 코돈 수(ENC)가 낮았습니다.
동의 코돈 구성과 mRNA 및 단백질 발현량 간의 연관성은 일반 세포보다 췌장암 세포에서 더 강하게 관찰되었습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 단일 세포 RNA 시퀀싱(scRNA-seq) 데이터를 분석하여 췌관선암(PDAC)의 악성 관세포와 정상 관세포 간 코돈 사용 및 서열 구성의 차이를 조사했습니다. 분석 결과 악성 관세포에서 발현이 증가된 유전자는 구아닌과 시토신(GC) 함량이 높고 특정한 동의 코돈 사용 패턴을 보였습니다. 세포 실험을 통해 동의 코돈 구성이 정상 세포보다 췌장암 세포에서 mRNA 및 단백질 발현량에 더 강한 영향을 미침을 확인했습니다.
title: Codon Usage and Sequence-Composition Characteristics Associated with the Malignant Ductal Transcriptional State in Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 췌장암의 악성 관세포 전사 상태와 관련된 코돈 사용 및 서열 구성 특성
